script_text: Aquarius, the cosmos just flipped a switch — you're standing in the crossfire. Mercury is retrograde in your 7th House of Partnerships, squaring Uranus in Taurus, creating sudden tension in relationships and miscommunications today. Transit Pluto is conjunct your natal Sun in the 1st House, making you feel powerful but dangerously stubborn. If single, a past connection resurfaces with urgent energy — don't ignore it. If taken, pause before you text; Mercury retrograde twists words. Career-wise, Jupiter activates your 10th House, but Mercury is there too — hold off on contracts until after September 13th. Avoid impulsive spending today; Pluto's conjunction makes every purchase feel justified but it isn't. Air is your element, and right now it's stirring chaos you didn't ask for. Follow for tomorrow's reading — something shifts for you by midnight.
